defaults.video_script: Messi scored in the fifth and thirty-ninth minutes as Barcelona erased a two-nil deficit. March two thousand thirteen, Camp Nou, Champions League round of sixteen. Milan had won the first leg two-nil at the San Siro. Barcelona needed to win by three goals. Messi scored after five minutes, then again before half-time. David Villa made it three in the fifty-fifth minute. Jordi Alba sealed four-nil in stoppage time. Was this Messi's best Barcelona comeback?
defaults.video_subject: Lionel Messi scored in the 5th and 39th minutes as Barcelona beat Milan 4-0 at the Camp Nou in March 2013 to overturn a 2-0 first-leg defeat and win the Champions League round of sixteen 4-2 on aggregate.
